ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a regular hexagon, and the right side is labeled with length 2. Each side of the hexagon is used as a diameter to draw a semicircle inward, for a total of six semicircles. The gray shading is located at the center of the hexagon, and is the region inside the hexagon but outside all the semicircles. In the figure, the semicircles on two adjacent sides form a leaf-shaped overlapping region near each vertex, for a total of 6 such adjacent overlaps; non-adjacent semicircles do not overlap. Reasoning: The side length of the regular hexagon is 2, so the diameter of each semicircle is 2, and the radius is 1. The regular hexagon can be divided into 6 equilateral triangles with side length 2, each with area (√3/4)·2^2 = √3, so the area of the hexagon is 6√3. The total area of the six semicircles is 6·(π·1^2/2)=3π. It is necessary to use inclusion-exclusion to subtract the overlaps between the semicircles. The centers of the semicircles on two adjacent sides are respectively the midpoints of the adjacent sides; their distances to the common vertex are both 1, and the included angle is the interior angle 120° of the regular hexagon, so the distance between the two centers is √(1^2+1^2-2·1·1·cos120°)=√3. The overlapping lens area of two circles with radius 1 and center distance √3 is 2cos^{-1}(√3/2) - (√3/2)√(4-3) = π/3 - √3/2. There are 6 such overlaps, so the union area of the semicircles is 3π - 6(π/3 - √3/2)=π+3√3. Shaded area = area of hexagon - union area of semicircles = 6√3 - (π+3√3)=3√3-π.

From the image, identify a regular hexagon with six inward semicircles, one on each side, and the shaded region as the part of the hexagon outside the union of these semicircles. From the text, the side length is 2, so each semicircle has radius 1. Compute the hexagon area as 6 equilateral triangles of side 2: 6√3. The total area of the six semicircles before correcting overlaps is 6·(π/2)=3π. The image shows overlaps only between adjacent semicircles near the six vertices. For two adjacent semicircles, their circle centers are midpoints of adjacent sides; these midpoints are distance √3 apart because they are each 1 unit from the shared vertex with included angle 120°. The overlap lens of two unit circles at distance √3 has area 2 cos^{-1}(√3/2) − (√3/2)√(4−3)=π/3−√3/2. There are six such lenses, so the union of semicircles has area 3π−6(π/3−√3/2). 图像描述：图中是一个正六边形，右侧边标注长度为 2。六边形的每一条边都作为直径向内部画了一个半圆，共六个半圆。灰色阴影位于六边形中央，是六边形内部但在所有半圆之外的区域。图中相邻两条边上的半圆在每个顶点附近形成一个叶形重叠区域，共 6 个这样的相邻重叠；非相邻半圆没有重叠。

推理：正六边形边长为 2，所以每个半圆的直径为 2，半径为 1。正六边形可分成 6 个边长为 2 的等边三角形，每个面积为 (√3/4)·2^2 = √3，因此六边形面积为 6√3。六个半圆面积总和为 6·(π·1^2/2)=3π。

需要用容斥扣除半圆之间的重叠。相邻两边半圆的圆心分别是相邻边的中点，它们到公共顶点的距离都是 1，夹角为正六边形内角 120°，所以两个圆心距离为 √(1^2+1^2-2·1·1·cos120°)=√3。两个半径为 1、圆心距为 √3 的圆的交叠透镜面积为 2cos^{-1}(√3/2) - (√3/2)√(4-3) = π/3 - √3/2。共有 6 个这样的重叠，所以半圆并集面积为 3π - 6(π/3 - √3/2)=π+3√3。

阴影面积 = 六边形面积 - 半圆并集面积 = 6√3 - (π+3√3)=3√3-π。

method.method_draft: Use polar coordinates and sixfold symmetry. From the image, the shaded central shape is symmetric under 60° rotations, and each 60° sector is bounded outward by one semicircle arc. From the text, each semicircle has diameter 2, hence radius 1. Place the hexagon center at O and take one side midpoint M on the positive x-axis. The apothem of a regular hexagon of side 2 is OM=√3. In the sector −π/6≤θ≤π/6 about OM, a ray from O remains shaded until it first meets the unit circle centered at M. The boundary radius r satisfies (r cos θ−√3)^2+(r sin θ)^2=1, so the inner intersection is r(θ)=√3 cos θ−√(1−3 sin^2 θ). The area of one sector is (1/2)∫_{−π/6}^{π/6}r(θ)^2 dθ, and the total shaded area is 6 times this. Evaluating the integral, using u=√3 sin θ for the square-root term, gives one-sector area √3/2−π/6, so the total area is 6(√3/2−π/6)=3√3−π.

图像描述：附图显示一个正六边形，右侧边标注长度为 2。六边形的每一条边都作为一个向内半圆的直径，六个半圆弧都画在六边形内部。中央有一个灰色阴影的六重对称曲边区域，它位于六边形内部且在所有半圆外部。

推理：利用图中的 60° 旋转对称性，只求一个 60° 扇形内的阴影面积，再乘以 6。正六边形边长为 2，所以每个半圆的直径为 2、半径为 1。设六边形中心为 O，取某一边的中点 M 在正 x 轴方向。正六边形的内切圆半径即 apothem 为 OM = sqrt(3)。

在关于 OM 的扇形 -pi/6 <= theta <= pi/6 中，从 O 发出的射线先处于阴影区域，直到第一次碰到以 M 为圆心、半径 1 的圆。该边界点的极径 r 满足：
(r cos theta - sqrt(3))^2 + (r sin theta)^2 = 1。
化简得 r^2 - 2sqrt(3)r cos theta + 2 = 0，所以内侧交点为
r(theta) = sqrt(3) cos theta - sqrt(1 - 3 sin^2 theta)。

一个 60° 扇形中的阴影面积为
A_1 = (1/2) integral from -pi/6 to pi/6 of r(theta)^2 dtheta。
利用对称性，
A_1 = integral from 0 to pi/6 of [sqrt(3) cos theta - sqrt(1 - 3 sin^2 theta)]^2 dtheta。
展开后可写为
A_1 = integral from 0 to pi/6 of [4 - 6 sin^2 theta - 2sqrt(3) cos theta sqrt(1 - 3 sin^2 theta)] dtheta。
前半部分积分为
integral from 0 to pi/6 of (4 - 6 sin^2 theta) dtheta = pi/6 + 3sqrt(3)/4。
后半部分令 u = sqrt(3) sin theta，则 du = sqrt(3) cos theta dtheta，得到
integral from 0 to pi/6 of 2sqrt(3) cos theta sqrt(1 - 3 sin^2 theta) dtheta = 2 integral from 0 to sqrt(3)/2 of sqrt(1-u^2) du = sqrt(3)/4 + pi/3。
因此
A_1 = pi/6 + 3sqrt(3)/4 - (sqrt(3)/4 + pi/3) = sqrt(3)/2 - pi/6。
总阴影面积为
6A_1 = 6(sqrt(3)/2 - pi/6) = 3sqrt(3) - pi。

integral from 0 to pi/6 of (4 - 6 sin^2 theta) dtheta = pi/6 + 3sqrt(3)/4。
后半部分令 u = sqrt(3) sin theta，则 du = sqrt(3) cos theta dtheta，得到
integral from 0 to pi/6 of 2sqrt(3) cos theta sqrt(1 - 3 sin^2 theta) dtheta = 2 integral from 0 to sqrt(3)/2 of sqrt(1-u^2) du = sqrt(3)/4 + pi/3。
因此
A_1 = pi/6 + 3sqrt(3)/4 - (sqrt(3)/4 + pi/3) = sqrt(3)/2 - pi/6。
总阴影面积为
6A_1 = 6(sqrt(3)/2 - pi/6) = 3sqrt(3) - pi。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, six semicircles lie in the interior of a regular hexagon with side length $2$ so that the diameters of the semicircles coincide with the sides of the hexagon. What is the area of the shaded region inside the hexagon but outside all of the semicircles?
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure there is a regular hexagon, and the right side is labeled with length 2. Each side of the hexagon is used as a diameter to draw a semicircle inward, for a total of six semicircles. The gray shading is located at the center of the hexagon, and is the region inside the hexagon but outside all the semicircles. In the figure, the semicircles on two adjacent sides form a leaf-shaped overlapping region near each vertex, for a total of 6 such adjacent overlaps; non-adjacent semicircles do not overlap.

Reasoning: The side length of the regular hexagon is 2, so the diameter of each semicircle is 2, and the radius is 1. The regular hexagon can be divided into 6 equilateral triangles with side length 2, each with area (√3/4)·2^2 = √3, so the area of the hexagon is 6√3. The total area of the six semicircles is 6·(π·1^2/2)=3π.

It is necessary to use inclusion-exclusion to subtract the overlaps between the semicircles. The centers of the semicircles on two adjacent sides are respectively the midpoints of the adjacent sides; their distances to the common vertex are both 1, and the included angle is the interior angle 120° of the regular hexagon, so the distance between the two centers is √(1^2+1^2-2·1·1·cos120°)=√3. The overlapping lens area of two circles with radius 1 and center distance √3 is 2cos^{-1}(√3/2) - (√3/2)√(4-3) = π/3 - √3/2. There are 6 such overlaps, so the union area of the semicircles is 3π - 6(π/3 - √3/2)=π+3√3.

Shaded area = area of hexagon - union area of semicircles = 6√3 - (π+3√3)=3√3-π.
